blocks.text: Lakam, the older sister of actress-TV host Kim Chiu was placed under police custody after her arrest on Sunday, Sept. 20, over the 124 counts of qualified theft filed against her. In December last year, Kim lodged a qualified theft complaint against her older sister before the Office of the City Prosecutor of Quezon City due to supposed “serious financial discrepancies” involving over P44 million in corporate funds at their handbag company.
